artifacts.summary: Two-phase plan applying the REAFFIRM ruling as a dated amendment note to the pre-postflight-sweep deploy trigger subsection, then redeploying and discharging the full gate set.

memory_candidates.content: When authoring a plan phase's Tier Justification for a markdown/prose edit in the agent-system source store, do not assume suite_selection_select returns __FULL_SWEEP__. A guidance document under context/patterns/ can map to real shell suites (e.g. batch-orchestration-guardrails.md maps to test-deploy-baseline-lib.sh, test-deploy-ledger-lib.sh, test-gate-out-self-attribution.sh), because the selector keys on documented subject matter, not on executable surface. The justification's suite names must be run-and-matched against actual selector output; asserting the sentinel for a path the selector maps is treated as exactly as dishonest as a fabricated suite name.
